title: Pinwheel motif — lacy
subtitle: Extended chain arches between blade tips give an open, airy pinwheel in 4-ply
excerpt: Chain-4 arches between each blade tip replace the dc border of the basic pinwheel, opening up the outer edge into a scalloped lace ring. Five rounds in 4-ply cotton produce a 10 cm motif light enough for shawls and collar edgings.
sourceNotes: Weldon's Practical Needlework: Crochet, Volume 5 (1890), lace pinwheel chapter (Internet Archive).
heroPrompt: A lacy pinwheel crochet motif in fine white 4-ply cotton on a pale linen background, photographed flat from above in soft daylight. Open chain arches between each blade tip give a scalloped outer edge, 10 cm across.

crochet.gaugeText: Finished lacy pinwheel measures 10 cm across in 4-ply cotton with a 3 mm hook.

chartDefinition.title: Pinwheel motif — lacy
chartDefinition.caption: Five rounds. Rounds 1–4 build the offset blade construction. Round 5 replaces the dc border with chain-4 arches to open the lace edge.

glossaryTerms.definition: A loop of chains that bridges two anchor points without any stitches filling the loop, creating an open hole or picot in a lace fabric.

content.text: The lacy pinwheel extends the basic offset-blade construction to five rounds, replacing the dc border with
between each blade tip. The outer edge becomes a scalloped lace ring rather than a solid dc border.
Work in 4-ply cotton on a 3 mm hook. The finer yarn keeps the arches delicate. Pin the motif firmly when wet-blocking — the chain arches need stretching open to show the scallop shape properly.

attrs.title: Materials for one motif
attrs.body: About 5 g of 4-ply cotton. A 3 mm hook. Tapestry needle, scissors, blocking mat, pins.

content.text: Work rounds 1–4 as per the basic pinwheel motif but in 4-ply on a 3 mm hook, adding one extra round of offset treble clusters to deepen each blade before the border.
Join yarn to the tip of any blade. *1 dc into blade tip. Ch 4.* Rep from * at each of the 6 blade tips. Sl st to first dc to join. (6 dc, 6 ch-4 arches.) Fasten off.
Work the dense pinwheel for the same blade structure with solid dc filling between the blades. Or try the compass rose round for a different six-section lace motif.
